title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Illuminated Margin. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Illuminated Margin
options.lineage: tazhib — the illuminated openings and margins of Persian manuscripts
options.thesis: Your posture is the text; the margin names what went wrong with it, in gold, in words.
options.viewport: An illuminated opening spread: the live webcam mechanism demo runs inside the gold jadval frame as the text, a monumental Persian headline set above it, and the margin names the reason the instant posture breaks.
options.risk: A manuscript frame can read ceremonial and slow for a habit tool — the live demo must dominate the first viewport or the metaphor becomes costume. The margin must never delay the naming of a reason.

raised.raise: The Persistent Record: every named alert lands as a durable line in a living record that lingers — verdicts accumulate on the page as evidence, never as ephemeral chrome.
The Name-and-Shape Pair: no alert category is ever named without its silhouette — name and shape travel together on every card, chip, and margin note.
The Settle Grammar: state change reads as material — deviation lifts and cools the surface, confirmation settles it warm and flat, on every state in the system.
The Visible Armature: the measurement grid stays visible on the page — the baseline the user is held to is drawn, never hidden.

options.label: The Girih Lattice
options.lineage: girih — the interlaced star geometry of Isfahan tilework
options.thesis: Posture is geometry: the page is a girih lattice and the live pose is drawn on the same construction lines that measure it.
options.viewport: A full lattice field: the live demo stands on the visible construction grid, each alert category a named star motif, the register action set in the central medallion.
options.risk: The most familiar Persian-heritage move in this category — most runs land here, and that familiarity is the honest risk.

options.label: The Living Letterform
options.thesis: A giant Persian letter stands in for your spine, and one posture slider morphs the whole glyph grid live between straight and slouched.
options.viewport: A single monumental letter fills the first screen with the posture axis slider beneath it, the glyph grid breathing in step as it is dragged.
options.risk: A specimen is designer vernacular — a visitor can mistake it for a font foundry before the posture story lands.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: its one-control live morph is the purest demonstration of deviation and correction on the table; loses audience identification to the manuscript's mass fluency.

options.label: The Moonlit Shadow Lane
options.thesis: Your camera-cast silhouette is a shadow on a moonlit lane, compared against the good-posture shadow you calibrated.
options.viewport: A vertical moonlit lane where the visitor's own silhouette stands at the first stall, tagged with its deviation from the calibrated shadow.
options.risk: The surreal trading fiction muddies the offer the moment it outruns the compare-and-correct mechanics.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: silhouette-against-baseline compare is the product's measurement story made visible in one glance; loses audience identification to the manuscript.

options.label: The Midnight Transcript
options.lineage: green-phosphor terminals in midnight machine rooms
options.thesis: Named alerts print themselves as glowing transcript lines in a midnight machine room.
options.viewport: A blinking cursor over a growing transcript of named deviations, each line blooming as it lands.
options.risk: Terminal costume alienates the broad desk audience this product exists to serve.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it hands the working screen a costume of the tool the audience operates; loses both axes.
options.kept: Alerts as a persistent living record.

options.label: The Archive Wall
options.lineage: sneaker-archive box walls and colorway labels
options.thesis: Alert categories named like colorways, each with its silhouette printed on the box end.
options.viewport: A wall of stacked category cards; the live one pulls halfway out of the stack and the lid hinges open.
options.risk: Retail-box theater dresses a health habit in collector costume.
options.case: Fuses poorly: sneaker-archive nostalgia is not this audience's world; loses both axes.
options.kept: Name and shape never travel apart.

options.label: The Kinetic Relief
options.thesis: Posture states rise and settle as relief in warm gold sand under a rotating glyph ring.
options.viewport: A raised-sand ring of glyphs encircles the live pose; confirmation settles the relief warm and flat.
options.risk: A foreign cultural home and a control-surface costume on a consumer offer.
options.case: Fuses poorly: this is not the audience's cultural world and the form reads as an instrument costume; loses both axes.
options.kept: State change as material relief and warmth.

options.label: The Visible Grid
options.thesis: Letterforms built cell by cell on a visible construction grid, where the slouch is the one diagonal the system permits.
options.viewport: An enormous grid-built headline over faint construction lines, one diagonal breaking the cells.
options.risk: Design-culture abstraction outruns a mass audience's first glance.
options.case: Fuses poorly: Dutch modernist culture is not this audience's, and the metaphor is read only by designers; loses both axes.

canonCard.label: The Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: What posture SaaS ships, executed impeccably: centered hero over subcopy and a CTA, the dashboard screenshot floating below, three feature cards.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft: headline, CTA, floating product shot, feature row.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
